title: NeoOrigins Morph Definition
description: A named, reusable morph — what a morphed player looks and sounds like. File path: data/<namespace>/neoorigins/morphs/<morph>.json. A neoorigins:entity_model power references one by id instead of restating the same entity type, variant NBT and scale in every origin. A file here overrides the built-in morph of the same id (neoorigins:slime, magma_cube, sheep, cat, villager, creeper, zombie, skeleton, enderman, spider). Every field is optional: a morph may swap the model, restyle the player's own skin, or only retune sounds.

entity_type.description: Entity whose model replaces the player's. Omit for a morph that changes no model — a skin-only or sound-only morph.

nbt.description: Partial NBT applied once to the render stand-in, to pick a variant: sheep Color, cat variant, villager profession, slime Size. Ignored without an entity_type.

scale.description: Uniform scale on the morph model, and on the collision box with it when hitbox is true. Default 1.0.

hitbox.description: Whether the player collides at the morph target's size rather than their own. Default true.

render_held_item.description: Whether the player's held items are drawn on the morph. Default true.

render_armor.description: Whether the player's worn armour is drawn on the morph. Default true.

first_person.description: What the morphed player sees in their own view: `item` draws the held item with no arm, `arm` draws the morph's own arm holding it, `hidden` draws nothing. Default `item`. `arm` is a request — a model with no arm bone falls back to `item`.

arm.description: Name of the model bone to treat as the morph's arm, for first_person `arm`. Omit to work it out from the model.

skin.description: Textures layered over the player's own skin. Independent of entity_type: this restyles the player's real model rather than replacing it, so the two can be combined or used alone.

entity_sounds.description: Whether the player borrows the voice of entity_type. Default true.

sounds.description: Explicit sound overrides, layered on top of that voice. For what the mob can't cover: a silent morph, a pack's own sound, or a skin-only morph with no mob to borrow from.

texture.description: Body texture, as an asset id: `ns:foo/bar` addresses `ns:textures/foo/bar.png`.

cape.description: Cape texture, same addressing. Absent leaves the player's real cape alone rather than clearing it.

elytra.description: Elytra texture, same addressing. Absent falls back to the cape texture, as vanilla does.

model.description: Arm width: `slim` is three-pixel arms, `wide` is four. Absent keeps the player's own, which is usually what a texture-only reskin wants.

sounds.description: Sound-event ids (minecraft:entity.fox.hurt), not sound files. An unregistered id is reported once and then ignored, so a typo in a cosmetic field cannot silence a player permanently. Step sounds are absent by design — those come from the block being walked on, not the entity.

hurt.description: Played when the player takes damage.

death.description: Played once when the player dies.

fall_small.description: Short fall, four blocks or less.

splash_high_speed.description: The faster splash used when hitting water hard.
